features: 400W POWERFUL 5.1 HOME THEATRE: OBAGE CA-2 delivers powerful room-filling sound with a 5.1 speaker setup, designed especially for an immersive movie, music and TV watching experience.

35Hz–15kHz WIDE FREQUENCY RANGE: With a frequency response of 35Hz to 15kHz, the CA-2 is designed to reproduce deep low-frequency bass along with clear vocals and detailed highs, delivering a powerful yet balanced listening experience.

VIRTUAL SURROUND SOUND: Experience a wider and more immersive soundstage with Virtual Surround Sound. The CA-2 is designed to make movies and web series feel more engaging with better separation and cinematic sound effects.

GREAT CLARITY WITH POWERFUL SOUND: The CA-2 combines massive bass with clear vocals and detailed sound reproduction, helping dialogues remain clear while delivering the impact expected from a powerful home theatre system.

10-INCH HIGH GRADE WOOFER – MASSIVE BASS: Equipped with a large 10-inch high grade woofer that produces deep, powerful and impactful bass. Feel the intensity of action scenes, background scores and bass-heavy music.
